components.purpose: Group related actions without visual fragmentation
Primary action with closely related alternatives
Interactive compact metadata or filter value
Semantic severity with label and non-color cue
Compact icon-only action with accessible label
Consistent content containment and interaction surface
Compact semantic status or metadata label
Numeric entry with bounds and unit

convenience.purpose: Observable framework-agnostic state with atomic updates.
convenience.use_when: Local/page/session state must notify dependents without UI coupling.
Theme, density, sidebar, table layouts, filters, favorites or recent entities must persist.
Buttons or commands invoke service work.
Search/filter/data requests can supersede older requests.

convenience.purpose: Managed periodic refresh with stale/error status.
convenience.use_when: Monitoring pages need periodic data updates.

convenience.purpose: Delay bursty operations until input settles.
convenience.use_when: Search/filter inputs would otherwise create excessive service calls.

convenience.purpose: Prevent older responses overwriting newer state.
convenience.use_when: Concurrent requests can resolve out of order.
Business actions need consistent success/warning/error messages.
Application code needs persistence without direct storage manipulation.
Users should resume tabs, split positions and filter context.
Apps have several discoverable actions/navigation targets.

convenience.purpose: Canonical bundle of standard application services.
convenience.use_when: Generated apps need the normal framework services without repetitive setup.

convenience.purpose: Safe user-facing error IDs with structured logging hook.
convenience.use_when: Technical errors must not become raw user UI.

engineering.name: EngineeringEntityCard
engineering.when_to_use: When a named engineering entity needs status + compact properties

engineering.name: SpecLimitIndicator
engineering.when_to_use: Whenever a numeric measurement must communicate in-spec/watch/OOS state

engineering.name: OutOfSpecIndicator
engineering.when_to_use: When a spec violation needs explicit user attention

engineering.name: BaselineComparison
engineering.when_to_use: For KPI or engineering parameter comparison

engineering.name: ProcessTrendSpec
engineering.purpose: Process trend with spec/control limit context
engineering.when_to_use: For time/order trends of process measurements

engineering.name: DistributionComparisonSpec
engineering.purpose: Affected vs control population distribution contract
engineering.when_to_use: For population-shift analysis without implying causality

engineering.name: PopulationComparisonPanel
engineering.purpose: Summaries and effect-size context for affected/control populations
engineering.when_to_use: For exploratory comparison of two populations

engineering.name: CommonalityTable
engineering.when_to_use: For ranking overlaps/enrichment while keeping routing vs causal interpretation explicit

engineering.name: EvidenceCard
engineering.purpose: One typed evidence item with direction/strength/source

engineering.name: ConfidenceIndicator
engineering.purpose: Confidence label that does not masquerade as probability
engineering.when_to_use: For qualitative/model confidence; show percentage only when explicitly calibrated

engineering.name: RcaEvidencePanel
engineering.purpose: Evidence + contradiction view for one hypothesis

engineering.name: RcaWorkspaceSpec
engineering.when_to_use: For comparing several candidate root-cause hypotheses

engineering.name: EngineeringTimeline
engineering.when_to_use: For PM, alarm, recipe, process, and investigation history

interactions.purpose: Own validation, dirty state and submission anatomy
Keep complex filters out of primary page flow
Inspect an entity without losing page context
Create or edit while retaining current context
Focused blocking decision or short task
Persistent message scoped to a region

jobs.avoid_when: work that must survive process restarts

page_patterns.phone_behavior: Single-column reading order; actions remain reachable at top.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Metrics and charts reduce to two columns.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Filters inline; analytics above full-width table; detail drawer overlays contextually.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Filters become drawer; metrics single/paired; detail becomes full-screen drawer.
page_patterns.purpose: Interactive filtering, analysis, records and contextual drill-down.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Filters may wrap/collapse; metrics two columns; table full-width.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Master and detail remain simultaneously visible; resizable when valuable.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Master first; detail opens as full-screen contextual surface.
page_patterns.purpose: Browse entities while preserving selected-entity context.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Detail narrows or stacks based on content criticality.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Table-centered; create/edit in drawer or dedicated page based on complexity.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Priority columns; create/edit surfaces become full-screen.
page_patterns.purpose: Search, create, inspect and edit managed records.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Status/alerts lead, followed by KPIs, trends and affected records.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Critical status and actions precede compact trends and records.
page_patterns.purpose: Operational health, alerts and periodically refreshed data.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Priority health signals stay above the fold.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Facets and results can coexist; preview opens contextually.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Facets become filter drawer; result list owns full width.
page_patterns.purpose: Search and refine heterogeneous or entity-oriented results.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Facets reduce in width or collapse.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Local settings navigation beside constrained form content.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Settings navigation becomes top selector/list before form.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Navigation may remain compact beside content.

page_patterns.phone_behavior: Full-width step content with sticky safe-area actions if needed.
page_patterns.purpose: Guided multi-step task with clear progress and bounded decisions.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Side-by-side comparison wherever direct visual alignment adds value.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Baseline/current stack with explicit delta summary between/above them.
page_patterns.purpose: Compare baseline/current populations, entities or scenarios.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Two-column comparison remains where readable, otherwise stacks.

page_patterns.desktop_behavior: Minimal chrome; resizable panes; optional inspector.
page_patterns.phone_behavior: Single active workspace pane with contextual full-screen detail.
page_patterns.tablet_behavior: Inspector may collapse; primary workspace dominates.

performance.avoid_when: Data must always be read fresh.
performance.use_when: Deterministic repeated local result is expensive.
Multiple components can request the same backend data.

performance.avoid_when: A simple one-shot action is enough.
performance.use_when: Filters/search can rapidly supersede earlier requests.

performance.avoid_when: Content is tiny and always visible.
performance.purpose: Load expensive content only on first use.

performance.avoid_when: Only one or two requests occur.
performance.use_when: Many independent I/O operations could overload backend.

performance.avoid_when: Mutations are non-idempotent or failure is deterministic.

performance.purpose: Move blocking work off async loop.
performance.use_when: Existing synchronous library must run from async UI path.

performance.avoid_when: No decision will be made from the measurement.

performance.use_when: Same in-memory dataset is searched/filter/paged repeatedly.

performance.purpose: Build deterministic framework CSS once per process.
performance.use_when: Theme adapter initializes repeatedly across pages/tests.

runtime.rule: Use typed RuntimeConfig; do not scatter environment-variable reads throughout apps.
Set one normalized root_path and certify HTTP + websocket + static asset routing together.
Enable only with an explicit trusted-proxy allowlist.
Health is minimal; detailed diagnostics require authorization.
Treat failed error-severity checks as a release blocker.
Applications do not select their own NiceGUI version.
runtime.use_when: Record certified versions and deployment assumptions.

security.rule: Never infer permissions from display names or UI visibility.
security.use_when: Represent the authenticated user supplied by the company identity layer.

security.rule: Trust identity headers only from configured proxy networks.
security.use_when: Identity is asserted by a company reverse proxy/gateway.

security.rule: Authorization must execute server-side; hidden buttons are not authorization.
security.use_when: Protect a page, route, action, or data capability.

security.rule: Do not invent an untested CSP for NiceGUI; CSP is opt-in until runtime-certified.
security.use_when: Add safe baseline HTTP response headers.

security.rule: Validate size, extension and media type; active content is rejected by default.
Secrets, authorization headers, cookies, credentials and tokens must be redacted.
Generate server-side by default; trust incoming IDs only at a controlled boundary.

tables.purpose: Expand a record into rich contextual detail
